title: A product measure whose transversal measure is carried by a countable set is a countable sum of weighted parallel planes
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace, σ a Borel measure on ℝ^P, and Z ⊆ ℝ^P a countable set with σ(ℝ^P∖Z) = 0. Let ν be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(A) = ∫⁻_{t∈V}σ({y : t + y ∈ A}) dHⁿ(t) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then ν = Σ_{w∈Z}σ({w})·Hⁿ⌞{y : y − w ∈ V}. That is, ν is the Measure.sum, over the subtype Z, of the measures σ({w})•(Hⁿ restricted to {y : y − w ∈ V}).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)), Z.Countable → σ Zᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => σ {(w : Euclid P)} • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V})
